edges.reason: msg.sender is captured as newOwner during construction.
msg.sender receives the contract ETH balance in withdrawStuckETH.
msg.sender is the token source for the airdrop loop.
msg.sender funds the private sale transfers in launch.
msg.sender is the destination of the low-level ETH call.
block.timestamp drives private sale sell dates and LP burn timing inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is stored into lastLpBurnTime by the auto burn.
block.timestamp is compared against the manual burn cooldown.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline.
block.timestamp is emitted in OwnerForcedSwapBack.
tx.origin keys the holder transfer timestamp throttle in _transfer.
_transfer triggers swapBack which performs several external calls.
_transfer invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on pair sells.
swapBack swaps accumulated tokens to ETH via swapTokensForEth.
swapBack adds the retained liquidity via addLiquidity.
forceSwapBack calls swapBack which performs external calls.
launch calls the router addLiquidityETH function.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call.
addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH external call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens syncs the LP pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens syncs the LP pair.
transferForeignToken performs an external ERC20 transfer.
swapBack sends ETH to devAddress with a low-level call.
swapBack sends remaining ETH to operationsAddress with a low-level call.
withdrawStuckETH sends the whole ETH balance to msg.sender with a low-level call.
_transfer performs fee arithmetic and reaches unchecked balance subtraction.
The swapping guard flag is set and cleared around swapBack.
nextPrivateWalletSellDate is written using block.timestamp.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is written using tx.origin and block.number.
The router swap calls back into the token transfer logic in _transfer.
The router liquidity call transfers tokens back through _transfer.
The ETH transfer to devAddress can reenter the token transfer logic.
The ETH transfer to the caller can reenter withdrawStuckETH before state settles.
The external ERC20 transfer can reenter transferForeignToken.

normalization_plan.reason: Transfer amount parameter is only meaningful within the _transfer fee and limit logic.
Sender parameter is used only by the _transfer checks and state updates.
Recipient parameter is used only by the _transfer checks and state updates.
Local fee accumulator exists only inside _transfer.
Deployer address is captured locally in the constructor.
Amount parameter is consumed only by the private swap helper.
Local swap path is only used inside swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount parameter is consumed only by addLiquidity.
Recipient array parameter is consumed only by the launch loop.
Burn percentage parameter is consumed only by the manual burn function.
Local burn amount exists only inside the auto burn function.
Replacement router address parameter is consumed only by emergencyUpdateRouter.
Local balance snapshot exists only inside swapBack.
Foreign token address parameter is consumed only by transferForeignToken.
Limit value parameter is consumed only by the max amount update functions.
